# zenOSmosis

> Open-source infrastructure, terminals, storage, and ML pipelines — reusable pieces of one cohesive system, built in the open. Built for systems engineers and curious builders.

zenOSmosis is Jeremy Harris's open-source studio and project hub at https://zenosmosis.com, with long-form notes at https://blog.zenosmosis.com. This is the complete version of https://zenosmosis.com/llms.txt, generated at build time from the site's own data (src/projects.ts, src/config/appConfig.ts) — the same sources behind the homepage and its JSON-LD graph — spliced with portfolio-graph.json schema v7, generated 2026-11-16T04:42:03.173620424Z.

## Main

- [zenOSmosis home](https://zenosmosis.com): Project hub, hero intro, and live GitHub and crates.io activity.
- [Blog](https://blog.zenosmosis.com): Long-form engineering notes, systems design, and Magnet Vector essays.
- [All posts](https://blog.zenosmosis.com/posts): Full post index for the garden and notes.

## Infrastructure & Ops

- [Muxio](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-muxio): High-performance multiplexing and RPC toolkit for Rust with transport-agnostic framing and lightweight extensible RPC primitives.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: WASM, WebSocket, Real-time Networking
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/muxio
  - topics: rpc-framework, wasm-rpc, websocket-client, websocket-server
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: foundation
  - connects to: [deepwiki-to-mdbook](https://github.com/jzombie/deepwiki-to-mdbook) (workflow)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [rust-oxdock](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-oxdock) (manifest), [rust-simd-r-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-simd-r-drive) (manifest), [term-wm](https://github.com/jzombie/term-wm) (manifest)
- [OxDock](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-oxdock): Dockerfile-inspired DSL for native builds, multi-node pipelines, and sealed remote execution with guarded workspaces and managed pipes.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: MCP, SSH, Remote Execution
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/oxdock
  - topics: build-tools, containerless-build, dockerfile-syntax, dsl, mcp-server, process-orchestration, rust-macro
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: middleware
  - connects to: [rust-line-ending](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-line-ending) (manifest), [rust-muxio](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-muxio) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (workflow), [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [jzombie-graph](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie-graph) (manifest), [jzombie-graph](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie-graph) (workflow), [jzombie-graph](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie-graph) (docs), [term-wm](https://github.com/jzombie/term-wm) (manifest)
- [reqwest-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-reqwest-drive): Caching, throttling, and backoff middleware for reqwest backed by a SIMD single-file store.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: HTTP, Caching, Middleware
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/reqwest-drive
  - topics: cache-storage, caching-library, http-cache, reqwest-middleware, rust-http, rust-reqwest, storage-container
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: middleware
  - connects to: [rust-cache-manager](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-cache-manager) (manifest), [rust-simd-r-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-simd-r-drive) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [jzombie-graph](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie-graph) (manifest), [rust-sec-fetcher](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-sec-fetcher) (manifest), [rust-triplets](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-triplets) (manifest)
- [Mosquitto Cloudflare Tunnel](https://github.com/jzombie/docker-mqtt-mosquitto-cloudflare-tunnel): Dockerized Mosquitto broker pre-wired with Cloudflare Tunnel, ACLs, and optional message encryption for remote-first MQTT.
  - stack: Docker, MQTT, Message Brokering
  - docs: https://docs.docker-mqtt-mosquitto-cloudflare-tunnel.zenosmosis.com/
  - topics: cloudflared, docker, docker-compose, mosquitto-mqtt-broker, mqtt-broker
  - layer: isolated
  - connects to: [deepwiki-to-mdbook](https://github.com/jzombie/deepwiki-to-mdbook) (workflow)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs)
- [sshfs-mac-docker](https://github.com/jzombie/sshfs-mac-docker): Containerized SSHFS + Samba bridge that mounts remote filesystems on macOS without macFUSE hacks.
  - stack: Docker, Linux, macOS, Samba
  - docs: https://docs.sshfs-mac-docker.zenosmosis.com/
  - topics: docker, macos, sshfs-mounting
  - layer: isolated
  - connects to: [deepwiki-to-mdbook](https://github.com/jzombie/deepwiki-to-mdbook) (workflow)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs)

## Virtualization & Terminal

- [term-wm](https://github.com/jzombie/term-wm): Spatial terminal desktop environment for remote workspaces: floating windows, tiling, and persistent multi-viewer sessions over plain SSH.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: PTY, SSH, TUI
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/term-wm
  - topics: gui, spatial-desktop, ssh, terminal-ui, window-managers, workspace
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: middleware+application
  - connects to: [live-assets](https://github.com/jzombie/live-assets) (docs), [rust-line-ending](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-line-ending) (manifest), [rust-muxio](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-muxio) (manifest), [rust-oxdock](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-oxdock) (manifest), [term-wm-vt100](https://github.com/jzombie/term-wm-vt100) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [live-assets](https://github.com/jzombie/live-assets) (docs), [rust-argtuner](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-argtuner) (manifest)
- [windows-headless](https://github.com/jzombie/windows-headless): Turns a Microsoft ISO into an SSH-ready Windows 11 VM in one command via portable QEMU.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: QEMU, Windows 11, OpenSSH
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/windows-headless
  - topics: command-line-utilities, headless, provisioning, ssh, unattended-installation, virtualization, windows-11, windows-headless
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: application
  - connects to: [lab-qemu-portable](https://github.com/jzombie/lab-qemu-portable) (docs), [rust-cache-manager](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-cache-manager) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [lab-qemu-portable](https://github.com/jzombie/lab-qemu-portable) (docs)
- [lab-qemu-portable](https://github.com/jzombie/lab-qemu-portable): Portable zero-install builds of QEMU and wimlib for Windows, Linux, and macOS, plus a mirrored virtio-win driver pack.
  - languages: Shell, Python, YAML
  - stack: QEMU, KVM, HVF, wimlib
  - topics: emulation, headless, hvf, kvm, portable, qemu, unattended-installation, virtio-win, virtualization, whpx, wimlib, windows
  - layer: isolated
  - connects to: [windows-headless](https://github.com/jzombie/windows-headless) (docs)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [windows-headless](https://github.com/jzombie/windows-headless) (docs)

## Filesystems & Databases

- [SIMD R Drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-simd-r-drive): Single-file SIMD-optimized storage engine that guarantees aligned, zero-copy binary reads across platforms.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: SIMD, Storage Engine
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/simd-r-drive
  - topics: append-only, binary-storage, key-value-store, mmap, simd-optimized, storage-backend, storage-container, storage-engine, zero-copy
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: middleware+application
  - connects to: [deepwiki-to-mdbook](https://github.com/jzombie/deepwiki-to-mdbook) (workflow), [rust-muxio](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-muxio) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs), [rust-llkv](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-llkv) (manifest), [rust-reqwest-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-reqwest-drive) (manifest), [rust-sec-fetcher](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-sec-fetcher) (manifest), [rust-triplets](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-triplets) (manifest)
- [LLKV](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-llkv): Experimental SQL engine that layers Apache Arrow buffers, a streaming executor, and MVCC over pluggable key-value pagers.
  - languages: Rust, SQL
  - stack: Apache Arrow, sqllogictest
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/llkv
  - docs: https://docs.llkv.zenosmosis.com/
  - topics: apache-arrow, database-systems, embedded-sql-database, rust, sqllogictest
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: application
  - connects to: [deepwiki-to-mdbook](https://github.com/jzombie/deepwiki-to-mdbook) (workflow), [rust-simd-r-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-simd-r-drive) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs)

  - stack: Docker, Fossil
  - docs: https://docs.sqlite-sqllogictest-corpus.zenosmosis.com/overview.html

  - stack: Docker
  - docs: https://docs.deepwiki-to-mdbook.zenosmosis.com/

## AI & ML

- [argtuner](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-argtuner): Language-agnostic black-box hyperparameter tuner CLI with PSO and successive halving over a TOML spec.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: SQLite, Hyperparameter Tuning
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/argtuner
  - topics: black-box-optimization, cli, hyperparameter-optimization, particle-swarm-optimization, rust, successive-halving, tui
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: application
  - connects to: [rust-line-ending](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-line-ending) (manifest), [term-wm](https://github.com/jzombie/term-wm) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs)
- [triplets](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-triplets): Composable deterministic text data pipeline for building reproducible triplets and pairs with BM25 hard negatives.
  - languages: Rust
  - stack: Hugging Face, BM25, Embeddings
  - crate: https://crates.io/crates/triplets
  - topics: algorithms, artificial-intelligence, bm25, dataset-sampling, science, text-processing, train-test-split, training-data, triplet-mining
  - license: Apache-2.0
  - layer: middleware
  - connects to: [rust-cache-manager](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-cache-manager) (manifest), [rust-line-ending](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-line-ending) (manifest), [rust-reqwest-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-reqwest-drive) (manifest), [rust-simd-r-drive](https://github.com/jzombie/rust-simd-r-drive) (manifest)
  - used by: [jzombie](https://github.com/jzombie/jzombie) (docs)
